The '''oak tree''' was a species of large, long-lived trees. The tree could be found on a number of planets and was a source of the nonmetallic element [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]].<ref name="Galactic Battlegrounds">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>
